regime_notes: No fresh ecosystem crossed the alert or paper-trade threshold since the 2026-09-20 01:42 UTC ZEC persistence checkpoint.

Hyperliquid remains the strongest continuation regime: stablecoin supply is about +4.37% over seven days, spot DEX volume +11.03% weekly and perp volume +26.46% weekly. Those are essentially the same confirmation conditions that justified the Sep 19 HYPE add, not a new threshold. HYPE funding remains far below the prior ~59% annualized crowding spike and no fresh independent selective-wallet cohort was verified.

Polygon remains a raw-volume outlier at about +135% weekly DEX volume, +43.4% weekly perps and roughly +$17.3M of 24-hour inflow, but current 24-hour DEX volume (~$160.7M) is below the trailing seven-day daily average and stablecoins are roughly flat/slightly negative. POL remains ineligible under the previously identified privileged adjustable mint-cap hard gate.

Arbitrum shows improving trading and bridge-flow metrics (+21.58% weekly DEX volume, +11.47% perps, roughly +$82.7M 24-hour inflow), but its stablecoin balance is down about 12.25% over seven days. That contradiction is too large to classify the move as retained discretionary speculative migration.

Solana, Base, BSC, Avalanche, Sui and Monad do not show a sufficiently clean combination of spot acceleration, retained stablecoin capital and unincentivized demand. Solana and Base spot DEX volumes remain in weekly contraction; BSC and Avalanche are also contracting; Sui stablecoins/TVL are firmer but spot DEX volume remains sharply down; Monad remains weak after prior reward-contamination concerns.

Aggregate RWA activity remains substantial, but no new direct-token trade emerged. Robinhood Chain still shows high Maple syrupUSDG collateral utilization near 100%, repeating the previously recorded usage signal rather than creating a new threshold. Abrupt changes in Solana RWA active-AUM figures appear methodology/tracking-sensitive while DeFi-active RWA TVL remains firmer, so they are not treated as fresh discretionary capital migration.

Existing speculative positions do not warrant a new action: UNI is below its latest add mark but protocol value capture remains intact; HYPE continuation metrics remain healthy but unchanged; AERO still has genuine tokenized-stock venue leadership with external incentive contamination; ZEC has retreated from recent highs but no second large-holder exchange-deposit cohort or other material thesis break was verified.

Marked paper NAV is approximately $10,549.95 versus $10,183.60 for the frozen passive benchmark, ahead by about $366.36 or 359.75 bps. No paper trade is justified; state.json and the immutable trade ledger remain unchanged.
